caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, lyre-shaped decorative metalwork design that appears to be a section of a railing or balustrade. The main structure consists of symmetrical, scrolling branches and leaves, rendered in grayish tones with shading to indicate depth. In the center, vertical bars resembling the strings of a lyre are topped with elements that suggest stylized flames or leaves, and at the midpoint is a horizontal bar decorated with a central rose flanked by two diagonal wings or leaf shapes. On each side, the upper corners feature carved floral ornaments hanging down, and the bottom section is composed of further scrolling foliage motifs and a bow-like detail at the center. The object is framed by two parallel, angled bars representing the top and bottom rails, both shaded to match the metalwork. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same object’s outline, annotated with measurements, and the signature “Edward Looser” appears below it. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Iron Bannister
